paragraphs: Nice work last week team. We ended at a team save percentage of 61%. Shoutout to Carter for leading the team with 75% and being the only rep in the 70%'s. Luke and Colby both had a team high 17 renewals and Wyatt led the team with the highest ACV at $731. This week our focus is the pending cancel list. Everyone has an updated tab on the Outbounds sheet. Make sure we are working each account all the way through before the end of the 10 day counter. If we can hit the team target of 740 accounts on pending by the end of this month, everyone will receive a 5 point bonus to their balance for the tier prizes!

prizes.prize: 2 hour Top Golf bay for 6 people
